why.title: What makes us different
why.local_body: Based in Laeken, we know Brussels. We understand local market conditions and the Brussels business landscape.
why.personal_body: You get a real person. Direct access. No phone trees, no transfers. One contact who knows your situation.

process.title: How We Work
process.subtitle: Your path to the right insurance
process.step1_body: 30 minutes. No pressure, no obligation. Phone, email, or office visit.
process.step2_body: We analyze your situation, identify risks, and research market options.
process.step3_body: Multiple quotes compared clearly. Our recommendation without pressure.
process.step4_body: You choose. We handle paperwork. Policy delivered within 48 hours.
process.step5_body: Annual check-ins, claims support, adjustments as your life changes.

about.title: About BDTS
about.subtitle: Insurance Expertise, Brussels Heart
about.story_body: BDTS (BDT Sironval) has served Brussels residents and businesses from our base in Laeken. We combine deep local knowledge with access to AG Insurance and the full Belgian insurance market.
about.what_body: We're independent insurance brokers. We work for you — not for one insurance company. We compare options and find the best fit, then advocate for you when you need to claim.
about.ag_body: As a trusted AG Insurance partner, we have deep product knowledge, priority support for our clients, and fast-track claims handling.
about.value1_desc: One dedicated advisor who knows you — no call centres, no handoffs.
about.value2_desc: Based in Laeken, we know Brussels streets, risks, and regulations inside out.
about.value3_desc: We work for you, not an insurer — comparing the whole market to find your best deal.
about.value4_desc: Same-day replies, fast claims support, and annual check-ins as your life changes.
